goal: Build a Spanish ESO/Bachillerato web app that names drawn organic molecules (hydrocarbons, rings, functional groups) by IUPAC 2013 rules.

phases.title: Project scaffold
phases.summary: Creates the repo skeleton, HTML shell, CSS, single-file build and test tooling.

phases.title: Molecule model, validation, SMILES subset
phases.summary: Adds the molecule graph model, validation messages, canonical tree key and SMILES parser.

phases.title: Naming engine I: unbranched chains
phases.summary: Defines naming contracts and lexicon and names unbranched alkanes, alkenes and alkynes.

phases.title: Naming engine II: parent chain
phases.summary: Selects the parent chain and numbering (P1–P4, N1–N4) and names simple straight-chain substituents.

phases.title: Naming engine III: substituents
phases.summary: Names branched and unsaturated substituents recursively, with isopropil, PIN and substituted styles.

phases.title: Naming: ylidene groups and fixtures
phases.summary: Names doubly attached -iliden substituents at any depth, removes every unsupported path and grows the fixture set to 176 justified rows.

phases.title: Naming oracle
phases.summary: Adds an English renderer, an OPSIN round-trip oracle and graph-invariance tests; about 37,000 molecules checked with no naming bugs.

phases.title: Editor core
phases.summary: Builds the SVG drawing editor: carbons, bonds, erase, undo/redo, validation toasts, collision checks and a test API.

phases.title: Editor extras
phases.summary: Adds chain tool, move/marquee, pan/zoom, label toggle, live formula, autosave with recentring, shortcuts and chemical vs coordinate edit events.

phases.title: Explanation and results panel
phases.summary: Turns the naming trace into Spanish step-by-step explanations and adds the results panel with a stepper, alternatives and friendly errors.

phases.title: Redraw and examples
phases.summary: Adds the "Ordenar dibujo" canonical redraw with animation and undo, and an examples menu of 14 molecules.

phases.title: Polish and release
phases.summary: Adds the Ayuda dialog, accessibility and phone layout polish, e2e on the self-contained build and the English README.

phases.title: Visible carbon dots in skeletal mode
phases.summary: Marks every carbon vertex with a dot in skeletal mode so carbons can be counted at a glance.

phases.title: Single-bond drag grows a chain
phases.summary: Dragging with the single-bond tool grows a chain carbon by carbon, like MolView.

phases.title: 90-degree condensed-formula view toggle
phases.summary: Adds a toggle that draws the labelled-carbons view with 90-degree angles in textbook style, read-only while shown.

phases.title: Toggle to hide stepper highlights
phases.summary: Adds a stepper switch that hides or shows the canvas highlights and locant numbers.

phases.title: Editing in the 90° view
phases.summary: Makes every editing tool work while the 90° condensed drawing is shown.

phases.title: Author credit footer
phases.summary: Shows the page author and year in a footer and in the page metadata.

phases.title: Undo after Ordenar dibujo
phases.summary: Fixes Deshacer so it restores the hand-drawn layout after Ordenar dibujo.

phases.title: npm run deploy to Fastmail Files
phases.summary: Adds a documented npm run deploy that uploads the single-file build to Fastmail Files over HTTPS WebDAV.

phases.title: v2.1 Multi-element model
phases.summary: Extends atoms to C, O, N, F, Cl, Br, I with central valences and records the v2 plan in the design doc.

phases.title: v2.2 Multi-element SMILES and oracle
phases.summary: Teaches the SMILES reader/writer and the OPSIN oracle adapter about O, N and halogen atoms.

phases.title: v2.3 Element palette
phases.summary: Element palette places and changes C, O, N, F, Cl, Br and I; heteroatoms are drawn labelled with their hydrogens.

phases.title: v2.4 Ring infrastructure
phases.summary: Perceives and classifies rings, keys monocycles structurally, reads/writes SMILES ring closures and shows Spanish scope messages.

phases.title: v2.5 Simple cycloalkanes
phases.summary: Names bare saturated rings of 3 to 30 carbons (ciclopropano, ciclohexano…) and explains the ring closure.

phases.title: v2.6 Substituted and unsaturated rings
phases.summary: Names single carbocycles with side chains and ring double or triple bonds; the ring is always the parent.

phases.title: v2.7a Ring templates and inner double-bond lines
phases.summary: Editor ring tool places 3- to 8-carbon polygons, and ring double bonds draw their second line inside the ring.

phases.title: v2.7b Ordenar dibujo for rings
phases.summary: Ordenar dibujo lays out a named single ring as a regular polygon with side chains outside, locants and one undo step.

phases.title: v2.8 Benzene and hydrocarbon derivatives
phases.summary: Names benzene and single-substituent benzenes in either Kekulé form, adds a benzene ring template and oracle support.

phases.title: v2.9 Functional groups and seniority
phases.summary: Detects functional groups without overlaps and picks the principal one by seniority; heteroatom molecules are explained but not named yet.

phases.title: v2.10 Halogen derivatives
phases.summary: Names halogen derivatives with fluoro-, cloro-, bromo-, yodo- prefixes, multipliers and alphabetical order.

phases.title: v2.11 Alcohols
phases.summary: Names alcohols with -ol/-diol suffixes and hidroxi- prefixes, including cycloalkanols and fenol.

phases.title: v2.12 Aldehydes and ketones
phases.summary: Names aldehydes and ketones (etanal, propanona, oxo-/hidroxi- prefixes, cycloalkanones) and refuses out-of-scope carbonyls.

phases.title: v2.13 Carboxylic acids
phases.summary: Names open-chain carboxylic acids and diacids (ácido etanoico), with acid seniority over carbonyls and alcohols.

phases.title: v2.14 Ethers
phases.summary: Names ethers with alkoxy prefixes (metoxietano), choosing the parent side by explicit rules and highlighting both sides.

phases.title: v2.15 Esters
phases.summary: Names esters (etanoato de metilo), explaining the acid part and the O-bound group separately; Spanish and English orders differ.

phases.title: v2.16 Amines
phases.summary: Names primary, secondary and tertiary amines (-amina, N-locants, amino- prefix), including ring amines.

phases.title: v2.17 Amides
phases.summary: Names open-chain amides (-amida, N-locants, formamida/acetamida) and refuses ring amides, imides and amide prefixes.

phases.title: v2.18 Nitriles
phases.summary: Names open-chain nitriles (-nitrilo, acetonitrilo) and refuses ring nitriles, 3+ nitriles and the ciano- prefix for now.

phases.title: v2.19a ciano- prefix (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names a nitrile beside an acid, ester or amide, or inside a branch, with the ciano- prefix, its carbon outside the parent.

phases.title: v2.19b Acyl prefixes formil-/acetil- (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names a C=O carbon hung from its chain as a branch with formil-, acetil- and similar acyl prefixes.

phases.title: v2.19c Ester prefixes and diesters (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names an ester beside an acid with alcoxicarbonil-/aciloxi- prefixes, and diesters.

phases.title: v2.19d Amide prefixes and pair matrix (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names an amide beside an acid or ester with carbamoil-/acilamino- prefixes and completes the functional pair matrix.

phases.title: v2.20a Rings as substituents of a functional chain (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names a chain carrying an OH, ketone or amine with a ring hung from it as ciclohexil-/fenil- (lifts sideChain refusals).

phases.title: v2.20b Acids and aldehydes with a ring, ring acyl prefixes (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names -carboxílico/-carbaldehído on a ring (ácido benzoico, benzaldehído), those groups beside a ring, and benzoil-type prefixes.

phases.title: v2.20c Nitriles and amides with a ring (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names -carbonitrilo/-carboxamida on rings (benzonitrilo, benzamida), N-fenil amides, and ciano-/carbamoil- on rings.

phases.title: v2.20d Ring esters (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names esters with a ring on the acid side (-carboxilato, benzoato) or the O side (…ato de fenilo/ciclohexilo).

phases.title: v2.21 Condensed formulas and wrap-up
phases.summary: v2 plan phase 21: condensed formulas and wrap-up (autoclaude/processed/215-rings-functional-groups-confirmed.md).
